component.name: ProtonMD
component.summary: Diagnose why Linux games won't run

description.p: ProtonMD checks your GPU drivers, Vulkan setup and kernel limits, then inspects each Steam game's Wine prefix, Proton version, launch options and shader cache. It explains what is wrong and offers safe, confirmed fixes.
Unofficial. Not affiliated with Valve or Proton AG.
